trigger: User typing text on target sites
why_it_matters: User written content is streamed in real-time to external cloud servers which may contain sensitive personal or confidential data
mitigating_evidence: Uses secure WebSocket (wss://) connections and text is processed specifically for requested grammar analysis
reason: Inherent tracking risk due to cloud-based real-time analysis.

why_it_matters: Grants the extension capability to read and manipulate DOM elements across all websites on the internet
mitigating_evidence: Manifest content_scripts define a large exclusion list of sensitive domains (like bank or private tools) and restrict matching
reason: Technically excessive but required for editor widget functionality on arbitrary editing surfaces.

why_it_matters: Allows monitoring authentication state and cookie changes across domains
mitigating_evidence: Restricted specifically to synchronize Grammarly's own user identity session state with the extension
reason: Monitors identity cookie updates to synchronize session states.
